title: Basketball Data Repository
short_summary: Curated basketball datasets with exploratory analysis for analytics and BI use cases
summary: Dataset-focused analytics project providing structured basketball data for historical analysis, dashboarding, and modeling. The repository emphasizes clean, reusable datasets with supporting exploratory analysis and examples suitable for SQL, Python, and BI tools.

components.name: Scraped Basketball Datasets
components.objective: Collect and publish raw basketball datasets in a consistent, reusable format for cleaning, analysis, and BI consumption.
components.business_value: Creates a reliable starting point for downstream analytics (EDA, dashboards, modeling) and enables repeatable sports analysis without re-scraping/rebuilding data.
files: NBA Basketball Statistics and Performance Data CSVs

components.name: Data Warehousing Extract
components.objective: Extract basketball data from source files and standardize it into a controlled “landing” structure ready for transformation.
components.business_value: Demonstrates real-world ingestion discipline (schema awareness, storage organization, provenance) that reduces downstream rework and improves reproducibility.

components.name: Data Warehousing Transform
components.objective: Clean, normalize, and validate basketball data into analysis-ready tables (types, keys, naming, and consistent grain).
components.business_value: Improves data quality and trust—enabling accurate KPI calculations, faster queries, and stable dashboarding/modeling.

components.name: Data Warehousing Load
components.objective: Load curated tables into an analysis/model-friendly structure (relational tables or star-like layout) to support SQL and BI use cases.
components.business_value: Enables scalable querying and reporting by organizing data for performance, joinability, and consistent metric definitions.

components.name: SQL Queries
components.objective: Answer basketball performance questions using SQL (filters, joins, aggregations, and KPI logic) with reusable query patterns.
components.business_value: Produces decision-ready metrics and demonstrates ability to translate business questions into clear, auditable SQL analysis.

components.name: NBA Tableau Dashboard
components.objective: Build an interactive Tableau dashboard to explore team/player performance trends and compare KPIs across seasons or groups.
components.business_value: Turns raw stats into stakeholder-friendly insights—enabling fast exploration, pattern detection, and self-serve analysis without writing code.

components.name: NBA Power BI Dashboard PDF
components.objective: Document Power BI dashboard outputs in a shareable PDF format for review, storytelling, and offline distribution.
components.business_value: Provides a portable “executive snapshot” of insights that can be shared with non-technical audiences and used as a report artifact.

components.name: NBA Power BI Dashboard PowerPoint
components.objective: Package dashboard insights into a presentation-ready format with narrative flow, key findings, and recommended next questions.
components.business_value: Demonstrates stakeholder communication—bridging analytics to action by framing insights clearly for meetings, interviews, or client delivery.
